description: Defines classes and methods for RRC Dual-Connectivity implementation, including an adapter for UE-RRC DU communication and the main RRC DU class with cell and UE management.

classes.name: rrc_ue_rrc_du_adapter
classes.description: Adapter class facilitating communication between RRC UE and RRC DU, handling various connection events.

classes.name: rrc_du_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing RRC Dual-Connectivity functionalities, managing UEs, cells, and metrics.
